description_en: Charles V became Holy Roman Emperor in 1519, presiding over an empire where the sun never set. His reign saw the Protestant Reformation, the Diet of Augsburg in 1555 which granted limited rights to Protestants, and the beginning of Spain's dominance as the world's first superpower.
